title: Peanut Curry Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful peanut-based soup perfect for a chilly evening. This recipe combines the rich taste of peanuts with the spices of curry and the comfort of chicken noodle soup.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook until softened.
Add chicken breast and cook until browned.
Add vegetable broth, peanut butter, curry powder, and nutmeg.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add rice noodles and cook until tender.
Stir in chopped peanuts and coconut milk.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with additional peanuts if desired.
Refrigerate leftovers for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
